Customers make the choices they like, but how can you shape their decisions to skyrocket your business?  

Step into the fascinating world of Sales & Marketing Psychology—where strategy meets science. It’s not just about pushing products; it’s about understanding why people buy them in the first place.  

In partnership with Vivekananda Global University (VGU), Rajasthan, this UGC-approved MBA elective program is your gateway to mastering the psychology behind every successful sale.
aboutUs: The Sales & Marketing Psychology elective at Vivekananda Global University (VGU) is designed for MBA students who are eager to understand the intricate psychology behind consumer behavior and leverage this knowledge to drive business growth. In today’s competitive market, it’s not enough to simply know what products and services to sell; understanding why consumers make certain choices is key to influencing their purchasing decisions. Through this course, students will gain a deep insight into the psychological factors that shape consumer behavior, from emotional triggers to cognitive biases.
howWillBenefit: The Sales & Marketing Psychology elective in the MBA program at Vivekananda Global University (VGU) offers numerous benefits that will significantly enhance your marketing and sales expertise. By gaining a deep understanding of consumer behavior, you'll be able to predict customer actions, tailor marketing strategies, and address consumer needs more effectively. The course helps you build trust and overcome objections, which can be applied across both traditional and digital platforms. You’ll also learn how to shape customer perceptions, manage brand identities, and develop compelling marketing campaigns that connect with audiences on an emotional level. This program also provides the tools to excel in digital marketing by leveraging psychological principles to drive online engagement. Ultimately, the knowledge and skills gained will empower you to make more informed decisions, improve leadership abilities, and drive business growth, setting you apart as a future leader in the marketing and sales sectors.
